description: This file contains unit tests for WebSocket JSON communication within the WPEFramework project, including server and client classes, command parameter definitions, and test cases for JSON message exchange.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: JSON container for command parameters including speed, duration, command type, and settings.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: JSON container representing a command with identifier, name, base address, trick flag, and parameters.

classes.name: JSONWebServer
classes.description: Web server class handling incoming JSON WebSocket requests and attaching command bodies.

classes.name: JSONWebClient
classes.description: Web client class for sending JSON WebSocket requests and processing responses.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a command body to incoming request.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming requests or responses, verifies content, and processes command data.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for response data to be received.

methods.name: Retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves received data into a string.
